queries: SoftBank OpenAI March 2025 investment why artificial super intelligence

sources_considered.why: Primary investor disclosure explicitly explains its investment rationale, but cannot identify the exclusive causal mechanism asserted.
Read. It discusses both expectations and product progress, but adds no evidence capable of settling the comparison with genius.
Search result establishes an available fundraising announcement, but fundraising alone cannot establish the claimed cause.

evidence_items.explanation: SoftBank presents expectations about advanced AI and model development as part of its investment rationale. This documents an investor's stated expectations, not whether Altman's persuasion caused an investment bubble or outweighed some measurable form of ability.

unresolved_gaps: The claim supplies no operational meaning for bubble or super-genius.
The investor record does not isolate Altman's persuasion from technology, commercial strategy or other investment motives.
There is no specified counterfactual against which to test the exclusive causal attribution.
